title: 当 MCP Server 变了，用户原来的设置还算数吗？
content: This article examines "capability drift" in MCP servers—changes to tools, prompts, and resources after users save configuration settings. Analyzing eight open-source MCP servers over one year, the authors document six types of drift, including discovery changes, renames, contract modifications, and mergers. Using Exa MCP Server as a primary case study, they show tools shrinking from ten to two, renames with schema changes, prompt removals, and multiple tools merging into one. The authors argue that names alone cannot simultaneously serve as logical identifiers and versioned definitions. They propose a four-layer model separating persistent user intent references from immutable content identities, surface manifests, and atomic publications. The MCP 2026-07-28 candidate release improves capability freshness but does not solve cross-version identity or per-consumer release lifecycle needs.

title: 存储的“下一个富矿”，突然不香了？
content: CXL (Compute Express Link) is emerging as a critical data-center technology in 2026 amid soaring DDR5 memory prices driven by AI demand. Unlike HBM, CXL enables memory pooling and expansion across servers via high-speed interconnects, allowing cost-effective scaling without overprovisioning CPU-attached DRAM. Major cloud providers including Meta and Google are deploying CXL to repurpose existing memory and reduce infrastructure costs. However, leading memory manufacturers Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron have abandoned self-developed CXL controller commercialization, pivoting to third-party chip designers like Montage Technology, Microchip, and Marvell—strengthening independent controller vendors' market position ahead of anticipated mass adoption in 2027.

title: 51.79亿，携程挨了最重的罚
content: China's market regulator fined Ctrip 5.179 billion yuan ($720 million) for monopolistic practices, marking the largest antitrust penalty in platform economy history. The travel giant abused its 70% market share in online hotel bookings through a coercive tiered system forcing hotels into exclusive deals and price controls, plus unauthorized price-cutting tools that shifted all losses to merchants. The 7.5% fine rate nears the legal maximum, reflecting compounded violations spanning 2020-2026 with 1.66 billion yuan in illegal gains confiscated. This marked 17 consecutive days of operational issues since July 9, ranging from degraded performance to major outages. The disruption is particularly significant for Codex programming agents, where interrupted tasks can cause project failures. The incident highlights growing enterprise risks from AI dependency, as API outages now halt production systems rather than merely disrupting chat experiences. This is accelerating demand for multi-model failover architectures and creating opportunities for alternative providers, including Chinese models, to capture overflow demand—provided they can match reliability under comparable loads.

title: 科技股到底贵不贵？估值应该这样算
content: Tech stocks appear cheap by metrics like P/E ratios, but expectations act as hidden leverage that dramatically inflates valuations. When a company beats profit forecasts, markets extrapolate growth across all future quarters and years, then assign higher multiples. Institutions amplify this effect by continuously raising targets during rallies and cutting them during declines. This mechanism explains why stocks can surge tenfold on modest news, then crash violently when reality disappoints. Investors must distinguish between priced-in expectations and achievable fundamentals.
